purpose: the Memory Covenant's semantics as original machine-checkable formulas — the math behind the standards wedge

authority.note: candidates only; promotion to the locked reference requires Lean-proven carriers, exactly like F1-F22

candidates.name: deny-by-default-safety
candidates.statement: For a memory M with admission set A (the reviewed facts), a decision function d that reads only from A cannot be influenced by any fact outside A: for all unadmitted f, d(M) = d(M with f inserted into the carrier only).
candidates.expected_proof: filtering argument: d factors through the admission projection; unadmitted facts are in the kernel
candidates.formalization: lean/MC1_deny_by_default.lean. insertUnadmitted copies admitted, so mc1_admission_invariant and mc1_deny_by_default_safety are rfl. The hypothesis that f was not already admitted is unused. Depends on no axioms.
candidates.id_note: Formerly mislabeled F23. F23 remains the Λ uniqueness claim (Conjecture 1) in the formula atlas and in lutar-lean. Do not reuse that id here.

candidates.name: staleness-propagation
candidates.statement: If source s is stale at time t, then every result r derived from s is stale at t, and the staleness label is preserved under every derivation in the estate's composition rules. A stale record cannot become fresh by derivation.
candidates.wedge_use: candidate statement that staleness is not removed by the worst-take fold
candidates.formalization: lean/F24_F25_covenant.lean, f24_staleness_propagation. Induction on the input list and case analysis on Tier.worst. Depends on propext. Not definitional rfl. Not in the locked reference.

candidates.name: learning-monotonicity
candidates.statement: The admitted-knowledge set is monotone non-decreasing across review cycles, and no unreviewed candidate enters it: admitted(c+1) >= admitted(c), and x in admitted(c+1) implies x was reviewed before cycle c+1.
candidates.wedge_use: candidate statement of the review gate
candidates.formalization: lean/F24_F25_covenant.lean. f25_admitted_monotone is the left inclusion of append. f25_no_unreviewed_entry only puts a newly present fact in the new reviewed list, because both fields append the same filter; it does not say the fact was reviewed before the cycle. f25_new_admit_was_reviewed is that filter fact. All three are direct from the definition of reviewCycle and depend on propext.

candidates.name: confabulation-floor
candidates.statement: CONJECTURE: for the tested model family (0.8B-4B), there exists a fabrication rate floor on unanswerable probes that is invariant under fine-tuning across the three tested curricula. Five receipted measurements support it; no proof is claimed.
candidates.wedge_use: the honest flagship: a conjecture labeled as a conjecture, with the evidence on the chain

pipeline: MC1, F24, and F25 have candidate Lean sources under lean/ in namespace Puriq.Formula.Candidate. None of them is in the locked formula reference. F23 is not used: that id is Λ uniqueness (Conjecture 1). F26 remains a labeled conjecture until a mechanism is established.
